screenshots.name: desktop-windlass-unit-guide.png
screenshots.findings: Three captioned cards present equivalent power, time and speed values side by side with clear forward/reverse factor chips. Return control retains a visible keyboard outline; no clipping.

screenshots.name: desktop-ramp-conversion-practice.png
screenshots.findings: The calculation panel shows a readable current quantity, requested unit, contextual guide action and numbered relationship/substitution/result feedback. The cancellation factor and checked answer fit cleanly.

screenshots.name: dark-phone-screw-unit-guide.png
screenshots.findings: At a 320-pixel viewport the dark guide stacks equivalent readings and wraps factor chips and explanatory text. White text, card borders and the return-control focus outline remain readable without clipping.

screenshots.name: forced-colors-windlass-unit-guide.png
screenshots.findings: Forced colors retains card/value/factor boundaries, readable mathematical symbols, separate factor chips and a clear return-control focus outline at 320 pixels. Meaning does not depend on color.

limitations: Local native Chromium with software WebGL; no deployed host was tested.
Forced colors was emulated; no physical assistive-technology session was performed.
